data.exact_reserve_text: Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 improved by GBP 12.4m in calendar year 2015. Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2013 improved by GBP 10.6m in calendar year 2014.
data.standardized_narrative: During 2015 Syndicate 1400 recorded a gross release on prior year claims reserves of approximately GBP 21.5m (c. 7.0% of opening gross claims reserves), corresponding to a net release of GBP 12.4m reported in the accounts. The improvement was driven by favourable claims development on older underwriting years (notably 2011 and earlier) and associated reinsurance recoveries. The figure was calculated from the syndicate's gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: release from prior year reserves of GBP 12.4m (2014, GBP 10.6m release)
Net reserves for claims outstanding at 31 December 2014 improved by GBP 12.4m in calendar year 2015.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was not provided explicitly as a single 'movement in prior years' gross figure. The gross PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 28-29). Net releases disclosed in the report (GBP 12.4m) were used as a cross-check. Triangle includes an 'All prior years' aggregate column which was excluded from underwriting_years per instructions; calculations exclude the two most recent underwriting years as required.
